sloka: शंकया एतया अहम् च दृष्ट्वा त्वाम् अपि राघव ।न उपसर्पामि अहम् भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति ॥४-८-३५॥
transliteration: śaṁkayā etayā aham ca dṛṣṭvā tvām api rāghava ।na upasarpāmi aham bhīto bhaye sarve hi bibhyati ॥4-8-35॥

translations.english: 'It is because of suspicion that I did not approach you. Every one is scared when there is ample reason to fear.
